043package dev.visdb.seesaw.datasources;
044
045import java.io.PrintStream;
046import java.lang.System.Logger;
047import java.sql.SQLException;
048import java.sql.Wrapper;
049import java.util.ArrayList;
050import java.util.List;
051import java.util.function.Consumer;
052
053import javax.sql.rowset.CachedRowSet;
054import javax.sql.rowset.spi.SyncResolver;
055
056import dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.JStuff;
057
058import static dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.JStuff.sf;
059import static java.lang.System.Logger.Level.*;
060import static javax.sql.rowset.spi.SyncResolver.DELETE_ROW_CONFLICT;
061import static javax.sql.rowset.spi.SyncResolver.INSERT_ROW_CONFLICT;
062import static javax.sql.rowset.spi.SyncResolver.NO_ROW_CONFLICT;
063import static javax.sql.rowset.spi.SyncResolver.UPDATE_ROW_CONFLICT;
064/**
065 * Sql related.
066 */
067public class Utils {
068  private Utils() {}
069  private static final Logger logger = JStuff.getLogger();
070
071  /**
072   * Return either the unwrapped object of the specified type or null.
073   * @param <T>
074   * @param wrappedObj
075   * @param clazz
076   * @return
077   */
078  public static <T extends Wrapper> T unwrap(T wrappedObj, Class<T> clazz) {
079    try {
080      if (!wrappedObj.isWrapperFor(clazz))
081        return null;
082      return wrappedObj.unwrap(clazz);
083    } catch (SQLException ex) {
084      return null;
085    }
086  }
087
088  /**
089   * Output conflict information after acceptChanges from the
090   * specified SyncResolver. For test and debug;
091   * note that SyncResolver is "used up" with default implementation
092   * since rowset navigation doesn't work.
093   *
094   * @param out
095   * @param resolver
096   * @param crs
097   */
098  static void dumpConflict(Consumer<String> out, List<ConflictRow> conflictRows) {
099    out.accept("=== SyncResolver ===");
100    for (ConflictRow cRow : conflictRows) {
101      out.accept(sf("    Row %d, status: %s", cRow.row(), conflictStatus(cRow.status())));
102      for (ConflictColumn cc : cRow.conflictCol())
103        out.accept(sf("    column %d, conflict: '%s', crs: '%s'", cc.columnIndex, cc.resolveValue(),
104                      cc.crsValue));
105    }
106    if (Boolean.FALSE)
107      dumpConflict(out, null, null);
108  }
109
110  /**
111   * Output conflict information after acceptChanges from the
112   * specified SyncResolver. For test and debug;
113   * note that SyncResolver is "used up" with default implementation
114   * since rowset navigation doesn't work.
115   *
116   * @param out
117   * @param resolver
118   * @param crs
119   */
120  static void dumpConflict(Consumer<String> out, SyncResolver resolver, CachedRowSet crs) {
121    try {
122      dumpConflict(out, collectConflict(resolver, crs));
123    } catch (SQLException ex) {
124      logger.log(ERROR, "dumping SyncResolver conflicts", ex);
125    }
126  }
127
128  record ConflictColumn(int columnIndex, Object resolveValue, Object crsValue) {}
129  record ConflictRow(int row, int status, List<ConflictColumn> conflictCol) {}
130
131  static List<ConflictRow> collectConflictNoThrow(SyncResolver sr, CachedRowSet crs) {
132    List<ConflictRow> conflicts = null;
133    try {
134      conflicts = collectConflict(sr, crs);
135    } catch (SQLException ex) {
136      logger.log(ERROR, "Collecting SyncResolver conflicts", ex);
137    }
138    return conflicts;
139  }
140
141  static List<ConflictRow> collectConflict(SyncResolver sr, CachedRowSet crs) throws SQLException {
142    List<ConflictRow> cr = new ArrayList<>(5);
143    int colCount = crs.getMetaData().getColumnCount();
144    while (sr.nextConflict()) {
145      List<ConflictColumn> cc = new ArrayList<>(colCount);
146      int row = sr.getRow();
147      crs.absolute(row);
148
149      for (int j = 1; j <= colCount; j++) {
150        cc.add(new ConflictColumn(j, sr.getConflictValue(j), crs.getObject(j)));
151      }
152      cr.add(new ConflictRow(row, sr.getStatus(), cc));
153    }
154    return cr;
155  }
156
157  /**
158   * Output conflict information from the specified SyncResolver
159   * after acceptChanges; resolve. For test and debug.
160   * @param ps output info here
161   * @param sr from acceptChanges exception
162   * @param crs source of acceptChanges
163   * @param selectDB if false, use values from CachedRowSet, if true from database
164   */
165  // TODO: What about delete/insert conflicts
166  public static void processConflict(PrintStream ps, SyncResolver sr, CachedRowSet crs,
167                                     boolean selectDB) {
168    int initialRow = -1;
169    try {
170      initialRow = crs.getRow();
171      ps.println("=== SyncResolver ===");
172
173      while (sr.nextConflict()) {
174        Object crsValue; // value in the RowSet object
175        Object rslvValue; // value in the SyncResolver object
176        int row = sr.getRow();
177        ps.printf("    Row %d, status: %s\n", row, conflictStatus(sr.getStatus()));
178        crs.absolute(row);
179
180        int colCount = crs.getMetaData().getColumnCount();
181        for (int j = 1; j <= colCount; j++) {
182          rslvValue = sr.getConflictValue(j);
183          crsValue = crs.getObject(j);
184          ps.printf("    column %d, conflict: '%s', crs: '%s'\n", j, rslvValue, crsValue);
185          if (rslvValue != null) {
186            Object persist = selectDB ? rslvValue : crsValue;
187            sr.setResolvedValue(j, persist);
188          }
189        }
190      }
191    } catch (SQLException ex) {
192      logger.log(ERROR, "dumping SyncResolver conflicts", ex);
193    }
194    try {
195      if (initialRow > 0)
196        crs.absolute(initialRow);
197      // Following is an exception, looks like the JDK's minimal
198      // com.sun.rowset.internal.SyncResolverImpl is non-compliant.
199      //sr.first();
200    } catch (SQLException ex) {
201      logger.log(ERROR, "restoring position after dumping SyncResolver", ex);
202    }
203  }
204
205  /**
206   * Printable conflict status.
207   * @param status in
208   * @return conflict as string
209   */
210  public static String conflictStatus(int status) {
211    return switch (status) {
212      case UPDATE_ROW_CONFLICT -> "UPDATE_ROW_CONFLICT";
213      case DELETE_ROW_CONFLICT -> "DELETE_ROW_CONFLICT";
214      case INSERT_ROW_CONFLICT -> "INSERT_ROW_CONFLICT";
215      case NO_ROW_CONFLICT -> "NO_ROW_CONFLICT";
216      default -> "INVALID_CONFLICT";
217    };
218  }
219}
